csv_scope_of_work: The Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority (SEPTA) is soliciting proposals from qualified agencies for the LLine ATC Replacement Project. The qualified contractor shall be able to provide services that include but are not limited to completing final design, then furnishing and installing required equipment to replace the existing signal system and support the new M5 vehicle Automatic Train Control (ATC), Automatic Train Operation, Real-Time Vehicle Location (RTVL), Work Zone Blocks (WZB), remote Temporary Speed Restrictions (TSRs), Train-to-Wayside Communication (TWC) and New Centralized Traffic Control (CTC) Equipment.
